EXAMINATION REFORMS AND BEST PRACTICES The examination department has been continuously carrying on reforms in its examination procedure through the integration of IT in all the processes of the examination management system. The Examination Department has instituted several practices for the smooth functioning of exams and to assist the students with any requirement: (i) Special provisions for differently abled students have been created for their benefit. They are given separate rooms (if required) with adequate facilities for writing the exam and also additional time, if required. A scriber facility for differently abled students to write their exams is also provided. (ii) All previous years' question papers are available on the Learning Resource Centre and in the university library. (iii) A separate section has been dedicated in the Student Handbook to explain the examination procedure. (iv) Processing and publishing of the results in time. (v) Masking of answer sheet for a fair evaluation system. (vi) Viewing of answer sheet by the student on digital platform. (vii) Shredding and recycling of exam materials. Digital Valuation System (DVS) with API Integration: As part of ongoing examination reforms, the University has implemented a Digital Valuation System (DVS) integrated with the ERP through API-based data porting. This reform enables seamless, secure, and error-free transfer of end-term marks from the DVS to the ERP system for pen-and-paper mode examinations conducted by the Examination Department.
